temperatureMetric: Published median global mean temperature rise in 2100 above pre-industrial levels
climateModel: CAT MAGICC7 — not the dashboard calculation or FaIR
comparisonCaveat: Independent published scenarios, not rebased to the dashboard inventory. Emissions ranges describe CAT's low/high policy pathways, not a probability interval. Do not use aggregate CO2e as native-gas input to FaIR.
refreshPolicy: Pinned release; updates require manual source review. Re-run Analysis does not refresh this reference.

scenarios.label: Current policies
scenarios.definition: Published projection of real-world action under current policies; does not assume all announced targets are achieved.

scenarios.label: All announced commitments delivered
scenarios.definition: Assumes governments achieve all announced targets, including long-term net-zero announcements and proposals. An optimistic conditional case, not an equally likely forecast.

supportingSources.name: IEA World Energy Outlook 2025
supportingSources.role: Sector-level reference checks: energy, electricity, transport and industry.
supportingSources.caveat: CPS covers enacted policies; STEPS also assesses policy intentions. WEO 2025 has no updated Announced Pledges Scenario. These are supporting references, not additional model inputs here.

supportingSources.name: NGFS Phase V, version 5.1
supportingSources.caveat: March 2024 policy/pledge cut-off; NDCs excludes long-term net-zero pledges. Not the main user-facing reference or a replacement for the full-commitments comparison.
